plainLanguage: Cypress is outside Houston's city limits, so Harris County has no zoning and no building-code permit for houses. You still need a Harris County development (floodplain) permit and, in or near a floodplain, a raised floor, about 2 ft above the 500-year flood level. Your neighborhood's deed restrictions and HOA usually set setbacks, brick requirements and garage rules. Water and sewer usually come from a MUD, which charges tap fees and a property tax. State law still expects the house to meet the IRC with three independent inspections, and an engineer-designed slab is standard.
